changelog.title: What's New in 7.2.0
items: SteamLite-exclusive achievements — 14 trackable goals with animated popups
6 locked reward themes gated behind achievements (Centurion Gold, 500 Club Platinum, Marathon Redline, Streak Inferno, Unstoppable Solar, Completionist Prism)
Streak system — track consecutive daily play, 🔥 from day 3, Duolingo-style upgrade animation
Streak recovery — complete any achievement within 5 days to renew a lost streak
2 new free themes: Midnight Rose, Cyber Lime
Modern UI refresh — design tokens, glassmorphism, staggered animations, shimmer skeletons, glow effects
Fixed accent color picker not syncing when applying themes from the Theme Shop

news.title: SteamLite 7.2.0 — Achievements, Streaks & Modern UI
news.content: Version 7.2.0 adds SteamLite-exclusive achievements with 14 trackable goals, a daily play streak system with 🔥 indicators and celebration animations, 6 locked reward themes, 2 new free themes (Midnight Rose, Cyber Lime), a full modern UI refresh with glassmorphism and smooth animations, and a fix for the accent color picker not syncing with themes.

news.title: SteamLite 7.1.0 Available
news.content: Version 7.1.0 added the Theme Shop with 8 bundled themes, UI Editor for live CSS tweaks, quick-launch bar, command palette, game profiles, session history, and 14 bug fixes.
